pr_title: Allow alexa to stop covers if available
pr_body:

## Breaking change
<!--
  If your PR contains a breaking change for existing users, it is important
  to tell them what breaks, how to make it work again and why we did this.
  This piece of text is published with the release notes, so it helps if you
  write it towards our users, not us.
  Note: Remove this section if this PR is NOT a breaking change.
-->
Alexa is now able to stop cover movement instead of closing it when you tell her to turn off a cover. This change only applies if the cover can be controlled by utterances such as "open the cover" and "close the cover" or "set the cover to 60% open". In case the cover does not support stopping or does not support the previously mentioned utterances, the old behavior of closing the cover when "turn off" is used is retained.

<!--

-->
This PR allows Alexa devices to stop a moving cover if the cover supports stopping. If not, the old behavior of closing is retained.

I am not sure this is going to work.
It seems that either a Mode Controller is assigned, or a Range controller:

https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/9b989ff3d5c002752905729c36a5fb3d9c540042/homeassistant/components/alexa/entities.py#L540-L563

So if `SET_POSITION` is featured, it will add a range controller only. I do not think it is a good idea to add a mode controller as well in this case.
Else, id `OPEN` and `CLOSE` are featured, only the mode controller will be used. But if the shutter is to be closed, it can only be stopped if the state is `OPENING` or `CLOSING` IMO. But the mode controller must be used to be able to close the cover too.
Conclusion: I am unsure we can fix this, as proposed.

We might be able to implement a `AlexaToggleController` like is done for `valve`.

https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/9b989ff3d5c002752905729c36a5fb3d9c540042/homeassistant/components/alexa/entities.py#L1021-L1022

I have done some testing and have working prove of concept that allows to stop a cover using the `AlexaPlaybackController` API. This will not break the existing functionallity. If you are okay with it, I can open a new PR for that proposal.

issue_context.title: Alexa is unable to stop cover movement
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Telling Alexa to stop a cover sends a "TurnOff" command to the cover, which Homeassistant interprets as closing the cover, thus there is no way to stop cover movement halfway through.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2024.9.1

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Alexa

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/alexa/

### Diagnostics information

<not available>

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

_No response_

### Additional information

This issue seems to have been around for quite some time, reported here first: https://community.home-assistant.io/t/is-cover-stop-not-supported-by-alexa-smart-home-skill/381376/3
